name: intrusion_01
notes: cam_01/cam_02 originally pointed at data/clips/intrusion.mp4 and overview.mp4 -- both turned out to be synthetic vector-graphic placeholders (a flat stick-figure icon over a drawn 'ZONE A - RESTRICTED' rectangle), not real footage. YOLO11n never detects a 'person' in them at any confidence down to 0.05 (verified directly; the only class ever detected in intrusion.mp4 across the whole clip is a stray 'sports ball'), so this scenario could never have produced a real intrusion detection -- confirmed by checking the ORIGINAL pre-existing results/run_intrusion_01_*.json and data/alerts_intrusion_01_centralized.jsonl already on disk before this session started: they show zero intrusion alerts too. Repointed cam_01/cam_02 at the real people.mp4/street.mp4 clips already used successfully elsewhere in this pack; zone_A widened to cover most of the frame (people.mp4's tracked walkers pass through varying x/y, never a fixed narrow box) and GT timing set to match verified real ByteTrack detections (person present in-zone ~15-21s and ~28-34s), not an unverified guess.
